items.teaser: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot has confirmed that France will attend upcoming talks in Abu Dhabi to ensure European security interests are represented.

items.title: Russia to replace Norway in ice hockey championship as more countries vow to boycott games
items.teaser: In the new layout of the 2027 World Junior Hockey Championship, which is due to take place in Canada from Dec. 26, 2026, to Jan. 5, 2027, Russia will place tenth. As the lowest-ranked team, Norway will move down to Division 1A.

items.title: Russia was widening this bridge to four lanes for its Crimea road. Drones have now closed it
items.teaser: The construction cranes on the Mius crossing were hit too, Rostov’s governor said, leaving a key link to the occupied south out of use.

items.title: People injured and houses damaged in Russian attack on Khmelnytskyi Oblast
items.teaser: Firefighters extinguished a fire in Khmelnytskyi Oblast after Russian strikes damaged 12 homes and destroyed a house.

items.title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps reports 20,000 Russian casualties in one year on Pokrovsk front
items.teaser: Units of the Ukrainian 7th Air Assault Corps killed or wounded more than 20,000 Russian troops in the Pokrovsk sector of the front in 2026.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike four drone ground control stations in Russia and occupied territories
items.teaser: Ukrainian defence forces hit four Russian drone ground control stations in Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Donetsk oblasts and Russia's Bryansk Oblast on 7 November.

items.title: Russen melden Schäden an wichtiger Verbindungsbrücke bei Rostow
items.teaser: In der russischen Region Rostow ist bei einem Drohnenangriff eine Brücke über den Fluss Mius auf der Autobahn „Noworossija“ beschädigt worden.

items.title: Over 7,000 troops complete training under updated programs in Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps
items.teaser: More than 7,000 service members of the 7th Air Assault Corps of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have undergone training under updated programs over the past year.

items.title: Security Service officers in regional offices told to chip in US$1,100-3,300 for senior official's bail – sources
items.teaser: Regional Security Service officers are required to contribute US$1,100-3,300 each towards the bail of General Serhii Duka, a Carthage case suspect.

items.title: Germany cannot supply Ukraine with more Patriot systems, Pistorius says
items.teaser: Germany is currently unable to provide Ukraine with additional Patriot air defense systems, as doing so would weaken Germany’s own defenses.

items.title: Russische Luftangriffe: Erneut Hunderttausende Ukrainer ohne Strom
items.teaser: Erneut hat Russland die ukrainische Energieversorgung schwer getroffen. In der Region Dnipropetrowsk haben 600.000 Menschen keinen Strom. Das besetzte Atomkraftwerk Saporischschja muss mit Notstromaggregaten gekühlt werden.

items.title: A regiment a day: Russia lost 16,130 troops in a week, its worst week of the war by Ukraine’s count
items.teaser: Ukraine’s military says Russian commanders keep sending infantry into frontal assaults, and the daily toll has broken records twice in two weeks.

items.title: Sandu warns of new Russian attempts to destabilize Moldova
items.teaser: Moldovan President Maia Sandu has said Russia will soon make new attempts to destabilize the situation in Moldova and create an impression of instability in the country.

items.title: Schütze hat "radikale Ansichten": Polen nennt Todesschüsse von Krakau Terror
items.teaser: Solch einen brutalen Anschlag hat Polen noch nie erlebt, sagt Ministerpräsident Tusk. In der Touristenmetropole Krakau erschießt ein Mann sechs Menschen. Ein Polizist ringt mit dem Tod. Das Motiv des Schützen ist noch unklar.

items.title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps identifies its most in-demand military specialties
items.teaser: Units of the 7th Corps of the Ukrainian Air Assault Forces are most in need of personnel to fill combat positions, particularly riflemen, grenade launchers, machine gunners and designated marksmen.

items.title: Russen töten in Region Donezk fünf Zivilisten
items.teaser: Infolge des Beschusses der russischen Angreifer sind am 7. November fünf Menschen in der Region Donezk ums Leben gekommen.

items.title: Russian attack sets trucks and warehouses ablaze at transport company in Dnipro
items.teaser: Russian forces have again struck Dnipro, setting trucks and warehouses ablaze at a transport company.

items.title: Ukraine and Poland complete search work in Ternopil Oblast, no WWII mass graves found
items.teaser: Ukrainian and Polish experts finished a search phase at the former village of Puzhnyky in Ternopil Oblast, finding a chapel foundation but no mass grave.

items.title: Massive Stromausfälle nach russischen Angriffen auf Ukraine
items.teaser: Massive Stromausfälle nach russischen Angriffen auf Ukraine

items.title: Russia suffers record weekly losses of over 16,000 troops in early November – Ukraine’s General Staff
items.teaser: Russian forces lost 16,130 personnel in the first week of November, the highest weekly figure since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: One killed and three injured in Russian attack on Dnipro suburb – photos
items.teaser: A drone strike destroyed a house in a residential area. Two women and a man received medical assistance at the scene and declined hospitalisation.

items.title: Moscow police detain over 200 people, reportedly forcing some to sign military contracts
items.teaser: Detainees told the Russian Telegram channel "Ostorozhno, Novosti" that those over the age of 18 were "persistently" urged to sign a contract with Russia's Defense Ministry. Reports of police beating the detainees, smashing their phones, and prohibiting them from using the toilet later emerged.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia launches 115 missiles, nearly 1,900 guided bombs, over 3,000 drones at Ukraine in a week
items.teaser: Over the past week, Russia launched 115 missiles of various types, nearly 1,900 guided aerial bombs and more than 3,000 attack drones at Ukraine. If Ukraine cannot obtain anti-ballistic missiles from its partners, the EU needs to adopt a strong 22nd sanctions package.

items.title: Leiharbeiter: Nordkoreas Geldquelle in Russland
items.teaser: Nordkorea stellt nicht nur Soldaten für den Krieg gegen die Ukraine. In Russland sind auch Zehntausende Leiharbeiter tätig. Sie hoffen auf einen besseren Verdienst als in ihrer Heimat - erfüllt sich dieser Wunsch? Von Norbert Hahn.

items.title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps expands APACHI Unmanned Systems Battalion
items.teaser: In 2026, the 7th Air Assault Corps of the Armed Forces of Ukraine significantly expanded the 237th Separate APACHI Unmanned Systems Battalion, which was established in late 2025.

items.title: Russian drone strike on Dnipro suburbs kills one person, injures another
items.teaser: Russian forces have struck the suburbs of Dnipro with a drone, sparking a fire.

items.title: Russia has attacked Ukraine with 115 missiles and over 3,000 drones this week, Zelenskyy reports – video
items.teaser: Zelenskyy says Russia has also launched nearly 1,900 guided aerial bombs; the president has called for stronger sanctions against companies involved in missile production.

items.title: Zuerst überflog ein US-Spionageflugzeug den strategisch wichtigen Suwalki-Korridor, dann umkreiste es die russische Exklave Kaliningrad
items.teaser: Ein US-Aufklärungsflugzeug hat erneut eine Mission nahe Kaliningrad geflogen. Die Artemis II überquerte dabei zweimal den Suwałki-Korridor.

items.title: Russischer Drohnenangriff auf Vorort von Dnipro: Ein Todesopfer
items.teaser: Die russische Armee hat mit einer Drohne einen Angriff auf einen Vorort von Dnipro geflogen.

items.title: Russians strike emergency workers at attack site in Komyshuvakha, Zelenskyy responds
items.teaser: No emergency workers were injured, but rescue equipment was damaged. Zelenskyy said search operations continue after a Russian airstrike killed 55 people.

items.title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps carries out 8,000+ missions using ground robots in 2026
items.teaser: Units of the 7th Corps of the AFU Air Assault Forces completed more than 8,000 successful missions using ground robotic systems (GRS) in 2026.

items.title: Former teacher evacuated from Oleshky dies in Kyiv hospital
items.teaser: Former physical education teacher Olena Pyrozhenko, aged 56, has died in a Kyiv hospital after being evacuated from Oleshky. She had impaired motor functions.

items.title: Russian forces strike critical infrastructure facility in Cherkasy, power and heating disruptions possible
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked a critical infrastructure facility in Cherkasy, potentially causing disruptions to electricity and heating supplies.

items.title: Gedenktafel in Moskau: Russischer Geheimdienst würdigt DDR-Spionagechef Wolf
items.teaser: Im Westen ist der DDR-Chef für Auslandsspionage lange Zeit als der legendäre "Mann ohne Gesicht" bekannt. Das ist in Moskau anders: 20 Jahre nach seinem Tod erhält Markus Wolf in der russischen Hauptstadt eine Gedenktafel - dem heutigen russischen Auslandsgeheimdienst sei Dank.

items.title: Emergency power cuts introduced in Dnipro, Kyiv and five oblasts
items.teaser: Kyiv, Kharkiv, Sumy and Poltava oblasts and the cities of Kyiv and Dnipro are affected. Scheduled outage timetables do not apply during emergency cuts.

items.title: One injured and apartment block damaged in Russian drone attack on Kharkiv
items.teaser: One person was injured and the roof of an apartment block was damaged in a Russian drone attack on Kharkiv on the morning of Sunday 8 November.

items.title: Russian drones attack Volyn region overnight, fire breaks out at agricultural enterprise
items.teaser: A Russian drone attack on the Volyn region overnight sparked a fire at an agricultural enterprise in the Lutsk district. The fire has since been contained.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 199 Gefechte an der Front, Mehrheit davon Richtung Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: Am 7. November kam es zu 199 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: First Oleshky evacuees discharged from hospital: what we know about the others
items.teaser: The first of several hundred evacuees from Oleshky have begun to be discharged from hospital. Since completing their treatment, they have gone to stay with family members and acquaintances. The rest are continuing to receive comprehensive support.

items.title: Turkish President Erdoğan discusses efforts to end war in Ukraine with Trump
items.teaser: The Turkish president expressed hope that intensified diplomacy will bring results and pledged Türkiye’s continued support for efforts involving both Kyiv and Moscow.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 7, injure 19 in Ukraine over the past day, striking Zaporizhzhia Oblast over 700 times
items.teaser: Russian forces carried out 725 strikes on 53 settlements in Zaporizhzhia Oblast alone, injuring one person, Governor Ivan Fedorov said.

items.title: ZNPP loses external power supply, switches to diesel generators
items.teaser: The Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP) has lost its external power supply and is operating on diesel generators.

items.title: Russia reports damage to bridge on highway connecting Rostov-on-Don with temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories
items.teaser: A bridge over the Mius River in Russia's Rostov region has been damaged in a drone attack. The bridge is located on the Novorossiya highway, which leads to Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine.

items.title: Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant experiences another blackout
items.teaser: The plant lost its last 330 kV power line at 02:36 on 8 November and is relying entirely on backup diesel generators, raising concerns over nuclear safety.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 137 von 164 feindlichen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 137 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 7. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: War update: 199 combat engagements on front line over past day
items.teaser: A total of 199 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defence Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Kostiantynivka front sees most Russian attacks over past day – Ukraine's General Staff
items.teaser: Ukraine’s General Staff reports 199 combat clashes over the past day, with the highest number of Russian assaults recorded on the Kostiantynivka front.

items.title: Russian forces kill five residents of Donetsk region over past day
items.teaser: Five people were killed in Russian shelling in the Donetsk region over the past day. Three died in Kramatorsk, while two others were killed in Bilenke and Druzhkivka.

items.title: Drone damages residential buildings in Khmelnytskyi, leaving one injured
items.teaser: Residential buildings in central Khmelnytskyi were damaged in an attack by an enemy drone. One person sustained injuries.

items.title: Trump's son-in-law Kushner seeks to revive NATO-Russia Council model as part of efforts to end war
items.teaser: Jared Kushner wants parallel talks on a Ukraine ceasefire and European security, but European officials insist a ceasefire must come before any new security framework.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,606,400 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,290 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Demokraten im US-Kongress bereiten Hilfspaket für Ukraine in Höhe von $15 Milliarden vor – FT
items.teaser: Nachdem die Demokraten bei den Wahlen die Kontrolle über beide Kammern des US-Kongresses erlangt haben, planen sie, die Unterstützung für die Ukraine zu verstärken und zusätzliche Sanktionen gegen Russland zu verhängen.

items.title: Russians kill five civilians in Donetsk Oblast over past day
items.teaser: Three people were killed in Kramatorsk and one each in Bilenke and Druzhkivka. Another five residents were injured on 7 November.

items.title: Russian forces attack industrial facility in Rivne region
items.teaser: A Russian overnight attack caused a fire at an industrial facility in the Sarny district of the Rivne region, destroying one of its buildings.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 2290 weiteren Angreifern und vier Luftabwehrsystemen
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 8. November 2026 bei rund 1.606.400 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 2.290 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Temperatures to reach +10°C in Ukraine on Sunday, no precipitation expected
items.teaser: On Sunday, November 8, Ukraine will experience partly cloudy weather with no precipitation expected. Daytime temperatures will range from +1°C to +6°C, reaching up to +10°C in the Zakarpattia region.

items.title: Russia loses another 2,290 troops, four air defence systems in war in Ukraine over past day
items.teaser: Russia's total estimated combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to November 8, 2026, amount to approximately 1,606,400 personnel, including 2,290 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: ADF neutralises 137 of 164 RUssian drones overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defence forces neutralised 137 of the 164 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 7.

items.title: Ukrainian air defence downs 137 out of 164 Russian drones, including three-quarters of the jet-powered UAVs
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defence shot down or jammed 137 out of 164 Russian drones overnight, including 88 jet-powered, but hits were recorded at 23 locations.

items.title: Defence Ministry specialists destroy more than 480,000 explosive devices since start of war
items.teaser: Demining units of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and the State Special Transport Service, operating under the Ministry of Defence, have destroyed 483,702 explosive devices since the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion.

items.title: Blackout in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast: over 600,000 consumers left without power
items.teaser: Russian overnight attacks damaged critical energy facilities in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, leaving over 600,000 consumers without electricity; hospitals switched to generators.

items.title: SSU Alpha Special Forces destroy nearly 4,900 enemy UAVs, ground drones in one month
items.teaser: In October, special forces of the Security Service of Ukraine's (SSU) Alpha unit destroyed 4,883 Russian UAVs and unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) of various types, as well as 11 Russian command posts.

items.title: Russian forces making attempts to advance towards Radkivka in Kupiansk sector – Trehubov
items.teaser: Russian troops are making some attempts to advance towards the village of Radkivka in the Kupiansk sector.

items.title: Zelensky says more SBU personnel decisions coming after senior officials dismissed over criminal gang involvement
items.teaser: "Unfortunately, this week brought very different news about the SBU – frankly, disturbing, truly disgraceful, absolutely unacceptable things," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

items.title: Russia launches 725 attacks on Zaporizhzhia Oblast over past day: one injured – photo
items.teaser: Russian forces carried out 725 attacks on 53 settlements in Zaporizhzhia Oblast over the past day, including 26 airstrikes and 561 drone attacks; one person was injured.

items.title: Traffic across Dnipro Hydroelectric Power Plant dam in Zaporizhzhia to be temporarily suspended
items.teaser: On Sunday, November 8, traffic across the Dnipro Hydroelectric Power Plant (DniproHES) dam in Zaporizhzhia will be temporarily suspended.

items.title: 1,9 Millionen Euro Strafe: Finnisches Gericht verurteilt Kapitän aus Russland und ein weiteres Besatzungsmitglied wegen Sabotage an Ostseekabeln
items.teaser: Ende 2025 haben Unbekannte wichtige Tiefseekabel in der Ostsee beschädigt. Die finnische Regierung nahm ein Schiff mit russischem Kapitän ins Visier. Jetzt wurde der verurteilt.

items.title: Russia loses 2,290 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,290 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Russian attack on Odesa kills one
items.teaser: One person was killed and infrastructure was damaged in an attack by Russian forces on Odesa.

items.title: Finland studies Ukraine's experience with anti-tank fortifications along border with Russia
items.teaser: Finland is exploring the possibility of building anti-tank obstacles similar to those used in Ukraine to strengthen its defences along the border with Russia.

items.title: Prozess nach Sprengsatz-Angriff im ICE beginnt
items.teaser: Ein Mann soll im April bei Siegburg in einem Zug Sprengkörper geworfen und zehn Passagiere verletzt haben.

items.title: Power outage schedules to be in effect in some regions on Sunday, covering 1.5 to 4 groups
items.teaser: Electricity consumption restrictions will be imposed in some regions of Ukraine on Sunday, November 8.

items.title: Kyiv's bus fleet cannot fully replace all electric public transport – City Military Administration
items.teaser: Kyiv's bus fleet is currently unable to fully replace all electric public transport in the capital.

items.title: Senator Blumenthal to introduce legislation supporting Ukraine, calls for new US negotiators, Starlink controls
items.teaser: "Trump needs new negotiators—not fawning pawns who call this brutal murderer a 'humanitarian.' Congress must lead without delay," Sen. Richard Blumenthal said.

items.title: Anand expresses her position on abduction of children and Russian strikes on civilians to Lavrov
items.teaser: Canada's foreign minister said she would not invite her Russian counterpart to any meeting, but used the opportunity at the G20 meeting to convey her position to him on the abduction of Ukrainian children, attacks on civilians and strikes on energy infrastructure.

items.title: Russians attack Odesa: fire breaks out in city
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Odesa, causing a fire in a non-residential building and damaging a property on the night of 7-8 November.

items.title: Umfrage der EU-Kommission zu den Exportkontrollpraktiken bei immateriellen Transfers von Gütern mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck (ITT)
items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.teaser: Mit der Delegierten Verordnung vom 14.09.2026 hat die EU-Kommission die Aktualisierung des Anhang I der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung) auf den Weg gebracht.

items.title: Vorankündigung des 18. Informationstags Exportkontrolle
items.teaser: Der Informationstag Exportkontrolle (ITE) wird am 10. Dezember 2026 in Frankfurt am Main stattfinden.

items.teaser: Der Täter tötete vor dem Angriff seine Eltern und Schwester.

items.title: Police evacuate 28 children from Sloviansk and Kramatorsk communities in one day
items.teaser: In the Donetsk region, police evacuated 28 children from the Sloviansk and Kramatorsk communities over the past 24 hours. More than 1,400 children remain in settlements where mandatory evacuation has been declared.

items.title: Blackout continues in Dnipro: over 60,000 consumers left without power
items.teaser: Over 60,000 consumers in Dnipro lost electricity after repeated Russian attacks on energy infrastructure on 7 November; repairs will begin once it is safe.

items.title: Russia holds 385 Crimean political prisoners in detention – human rights activist
items.teaser: Russia is holding 385 Crimean political prisoners in places of detention, 113 of whom belong to the indigenous Crimean Tatar people.

items.title: Jetzt 9 Tote - Drei Leichen in Wohnung von Krakau-Attentäter
items.teaser: Neun Menschen wurden bei dem Anschlag in Krakau getötet, mindestens 15 weitere verletzt.

items.title: DIU's Prymary unit receives UAH 4.2M worth of combat drones from donors
items.teaser: The Prymary special unit of the Defense Intelligence of Ukraine (DIU) has received combat drones worth UAH 4.2 million from charitable donors.

items.title: Trump offers UFC Chief White House press secretary job to defend against 'Lunatic Left'
items.teaser: The U.S. president has apparently jokingly offered Dana White, head of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), the position of White House press secretary.

items.title: Russia to send senior diplomats, military officials to upcoming peace talks in Abu Dhabi
items.teaser: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov, who oversees Russia's relations with the United States and arms control issues, will join the negotiations for the first time.

items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag ist heute in Berlin eröffnet worden. items.teaser: Die befristete Allgemeine Genehmigung für die Lieferung von Gütern der Luft- und maritimen Verteidigung ist zum 20. März 2026 in Kraft getreten.

items.title: Anpassung der Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für Ausfuhren nach Russland
items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.

items.teaser: Near Huliaipole, the 237th Unmanned Systems Battalion is sending heavy drones against single armored vehicles that now shrug off cheap ones.

items.title: One killed in Russian attack on Odesa infrastructure
items.teaser: One person has been killed due to a Russian attack on infrastructure in Odesa on the evening of 7 November.

items.title: Polens Ministerpräsident Tusk - Drei Leichen in Wohnung von Krakau-Attentäter
items.teaser: Sechs Menschen wurden bei dem Anschlag in Krakau getötet, 15 weitere verletzt.

items.title: Belarus barred from 2027 ice hockey championships as IIHF weighs Russia's return after court ruling
items.teaser: Separately, the IIHF said it "continues to disagree" with an Oct. 30 ruling by the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) that overturned its exclusion of Russian teams from international competitions.

items.title: Kraków terrorist attack: Foreign nationals among dead and injured
items.teaser: One foreign national has been identified among the six people killed in the terrorist attack in Kraków, while five citizens of other countries were injured.

items.title: Tunnels and hybrid attacks: Russia digs in under Ukraine-controlled skies across 20-30% of Kherson’s occupied bank, marine officer says
items.teaser: Russia has switched from frontal attacks to a “hybrid” positional war on the Dnipro bank.

items.title: Drapatyi, Zaits visit marine corps headquarters
items.teaser: Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Major General Mykhailo Drapatyi and Commander of the Ground Forces Brigadier General Sviatoslav Zaits visited the command post of the Navy's 30th Marine Corps.

items.title: One bridge stood between Russia’s armored columns and Kyiv in 2022 — two Ukrainian engineers gave their lives to stop them in one of war’s most crucial battles
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has posthumously named Lieutenant Zakhar Kvasnyi, 22, and Junior Sergeant Roman Shymanskyi, 37, Heroes of Ukraine.

items.title: NSU-Mord in Hamburg: Aufarbeitung tritt weiter auf der Stelle
items.teaser: Vor über 25 Jahren wurde Süleyman Taşköprü in seinem Gemüseladen in Hamburg-Altona vom rechtsextremen NSU ermordet. Noch immer gibt der Generalbundesanwalt die Akten nicht heraus.

items.title: Ukrainian citizens unharmed in Kraków terrorist attack – Foreign Ministry
items.teaser: No Ukrainian citizens were injured in the shooting in Kraków that took place on the afternoon of November 7 and left six people dead.

items.title: Why Ukraine’s new Patriot deal won’t solve its biggest air defense problem? Expert explains
items.teaser: The US has approved selling Ukraine 500 PAC-3 interceptors for $2.1 billion.

items.title: Prosecutor's office building damaged in Russian attack on Kyiv
items.teaser: A prosecutor's office building was damaged in a Russian attack on the capital on Saturday.

items.title: One Western air-defense battery has shot down more than 300 Russian missiles and drones over Kyiv
items.teaser: The battery, from Ukraine’s 96th Anti-Aircraft Missile Brigade, has destroyed cruise missiles, Shahed strike drones, and other drones.

items.title: Hackers claim leaked Russian data reveals up to 450,000 war-related deaths in Ukraine
items.teaser: The groups said they obtained the records from Rosstat's internal Demography database, containing information from death certificates registered between February 2022 and August 2026.

items.title: Woman killed, others injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv region since morning
items.teaser: A woman was killed and several people were injured in Russian shelling of Kharkiv and the surrounding region on Saturday.

items.title: More than 60,000 consumers left without electricity in Dnipro due to Russian attacks
items.teaser: More than 60,000 consumers in Dnipro have been left without electricity following repeated Russian attacks on energy infrastructure.

items.title: Russian forces attack two districts of Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times since morning, one injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked two districts of Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times during the day using drones and artillery, injuring one person.

items.title: Naturschutzgebiete unter russischen Panzerketten: wie Invasoren Natur zerstören
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben auf dem Gelände des Nationalparks Pryasovskyj einen Artillerie-Schießplatz eingerichtet, teilt der Militärgeheimdienst (HUR) mit.

items.title: Military see no Russian preparations for breakthrough toward Kharkiv
items.teaser: The Joint Forces Group currently sees no signs of Russian preparations for a large-scale breakthrough, for example, toward Kharkiv.

items.title: Brisante Spionage-Akten - Marsalek: „Wir haben Sebastian Kurz gestürzt“
items.teaser: Ermittler prüfen mögliche russische Einflussnahme auf Österreichs Politik.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine expects results on air defense and energy at G7, UDCG and Coalition of the Willing meetings
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine expects results on air defense and energy support at meetings of the G7, the Ukraine Defense Contact Group format and the Coalition of the Willing, scheduled to take place this month.

items.title: Germany cannot provide Ukraine with more Patriot systems for now, defense minister says
items.teaser: Boris Pistorius called on other countries to increase their contributions to Ukraine's air defenses, adding that the issue would be discussed at the next Ukraine Defense Contact Group meeting in mid-November.

items.title: Death toll from Kraków shooting rises to six, 12 people in critical condition
items.teaser: The death toll from the mass shooting in the centre of Kraków has risen to six, with 12 injured people currently in a critical condition.

items.title: First evacuees from Oleshky leave hospital to join families in Ukraine– Lubinets
items.teaser: The first residents of Oleshky who were evacuated as part of a humanitarian mission have completed their treatment and set off to join their relatives in Ukrainian-controlled territory.

items.title: Russische Drohnen setzen Wohnhäuser und Lagergebäude in Kyjiw in Brand
items.teaser: Russland setzt seine Drohnenangriffe am hellichten Tag fort: im Schewtschenkywskyj Bezirk von Kyjiw sind drei private Häuser durch einen russischen Angriff beschädigt worden, im Stadtteil Obolon haben russische Drohnen ein Lagergebäude in Brand gesetzt.

items.title: Five killed, over ten injured in shooting in central Krakow
items.teaser: Five people were killed and more than ten others injured in a shooting at Krakow's Main Market Square.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine currently generating more electricity than it consumes
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that Ukraine is currently generating more electricity than it consumes, but significant power shortages persist due to Russian strikes.

items.title: “This is not Starlink”: 6-kilogram satellite terminal Russia claims Ukraine is using for deep strikes — what is it?
items.teaser: “I do not confirm or deny this information from Russians,” a Ukrainian presidential adviser says of reports on a new satellite terminal for deep strikes.

items.title: Zelenskyy condemns Kraków shooting as shocking crime
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed his condolences and solidarity with Poland following a deadly shooting in the centre of Kraków.

items.title: Life in Kyiv becoming increasingly difficult – EU ambassador on Russian missile strike
items.teaser: EU Ambassador to Ukraine Katarína Mathernová has commented on the latest Russian missile strike on Kyiv, highlighting the harsh reality of blackouts.

items.title: Ukraine’s ground robots just got much bigger — this one can haul 1.5 tons and evacuate three casualties
items.teaser: Ukraine’s National Guard has received a car-sized heavy ground robot.

items.title: Energieminister: Russland hat 18-mal Energieanlagen in der Ukraine in den vergangenen 24 Stunden angegriffen
items.teaser: Energieanlagen in der Ukraine seien in den vergangenen 24 Stunden 18-mal angegriffen worden, sagte der ukrainische Energieminister Denys Schmyhal in einem Online - Gespräch mit der Bundeswirtschaftsministerin Katherina Reiche.

items.title: Zelensky says Oleshky ceasefire shows Russia can halt fighting but Putin is unwilling
items.teaser: Zelensky argued that the main obstacle to a ceasefire was Russian President Vladimir Putin's political will rather than technical difficulties.

items.title: Over 3,000 Ukrainians face detention in Russia's migrant prisons
items.teaser: Over 3,000 Ukrainians, including former political prisoners, are reportedly being held in Russian deportation centres, known as migrant prisons.

items.title: Zelensky announces further personnel changes at SSU following Carthage case
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that further personnel changes will be made at the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) following the recent release of materials from the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine's (NABU) Carthage investigation, which implicated SSU employees.

items.title: Germany exhausts capacity to supply Patriot systems to Ukraine
items.teaser: German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius has announced that Berlin has reached its limit in supplying Patriot air defence systems to Ukraine and urged others to step up.

items.title: Italy's foreign minister targeted in cyberattack due to Ukraine stance, minister says
items.teaser: Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni expressed her full solidarity with Tajani and linked the attack to pro-Russian hackers, Italian media LaPresse reported on Nov. 7.

items.title: Zelensky approves draft law to reinstate asset declarations for all SSU employees
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has approved a draft law to reinstate mandatory asset declarations for all employees of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU).

items.title: BND soll jetzt heimlich auch Wohnungen betreten dürfen
items.teaser: Union und SPD haben sich laut "Politico" auf mehr Geheimdienst-Befugnisse geeinigt. Demnach soll der BND heimlich in Wohnungen dürfen und der Verfassungsschutz kriminelle Netzwerke beobachten.

items.title: Selenskyj: Russland setzte bei nächtlichem Angriff wahrscheinlich nordkoreanische ballistische Raketen ein
items.teaser: Beim Angriff auf eine der wichtigsten ukrainischen Energieanlagen in der Nacht zum 7. November habe Russland nach vorläufigen Angaben nordkoreanische Raketen vom Typ KN-23 eingesetzt, teilt der Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Ukrainian corps builds one-of-a-kind ground robots for war inside gas pipeline
items.teaser: Russian troops crawl through gas pipes behind Ukraine’s lines. Now Kyiv’s ground robots go underground too.

items.title: 100 years ago, Kyiv's young writers sought artistic freedom. Stalin's purges cut their experiment short
items.teaser: A century ago, some of Kyiv's most talented young writers had the idea to push back against the pretension and mediocrity they worried were taking root in literary circles. items.title: Russian attack causes power outage in Khmelnytskyi region
items.teaser: A power outage has occurred in the Kamianets-Podilskyi district of the Khmelnytskyi region as a result of a Russian attack.

items.title: Zelenskyy reports four Russian missile strikes on Kyiv's Pivnichnyi Bridge
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has stated that four Russian ballistic missiles struck the Pivnichnyi Bridge in Kyiv overnight on 6-7 November.

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte treffen Abschussrampen für Iskander-Raketen in Russland
items.teaser: Die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben zwei Abschussrampen für ballistische Iskander-Raketen und ein „Panzir“ – Flugabwehrsystem in der russischen Region Brjansk getroffen, teilt der Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russian forces attack Odesa, damaging residential house
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Odesa in the afternoon of November 7, damaging a residential house.

items.title: Private house damaged in Russian attack on Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district
items.teaser: A private house was damaged in a Russian attack in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district.

items.title: Russian UAV hits house in Kyiv amid large warehouse fire in Obolonskyi district
items.teaser: A Russian UAV hit a house in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district, while a large warehouse fire broke out in the Obolonskyi district on 7 November.

items.title: Russen greifen Charkiw mit Banderol- Marschflugkörpern an: Wohnhäuser, Oberleitungsbusse und Autos beschädigt
items.teaser: Die russische Armee hat die Stadt Charkiw mit Banderol- Marschflugkörpern angegriffen. Im Slobodskyj Bezirk sind Wohnhäuser, Oberleitungsbusse und Autos beschädigt worden.

items.title: Russia may have used North Korean KN-23 missiles to strike Ukrainian energy facility – Zelensky
items.teaser: Russia likely used North Korean-made KN-23 missiles in its November 7 overnight attack on one of Ukraine's key energy facilities, according to preliminary findings.

items.title: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence identifies Russians involved in airstrike on Komyshuvakha school
items.teaser: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine has identified a Russian colonel and six pilots responsible for the airstrike on a school in Zaporizhzhia Oblast on 2 November.

items.title: Zelensky posthumously awards Hero of Ukraine titles to two soldiers who blew up bridge near Irpin in 2022
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has posthumously awarded the title of Hero of Ukraine, with the Order of the Golden Star, to two servicemen: Lieutenant Zakhar Kvasnyi and Junior Sergeant Roman Shymanskyi.

items.title: Kinder sabotierten Bahnstrecke Leipzig-Döbeln
items.teaser: Manipulierte Bahnsignale auf der Bahnstrecke Leipzig-Döbeln sorgen Ende März für Aufruhr. Sofort treten Terror-Ermittler auf den Plan. Doch nun mussten die Ermittlungen eingestellt werden.

items.title: Zelenskyy reports four out of 36 missiles shot down overnight and Russian use of North Korean weapons
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that Russia deployed 36 ballistic missiles, including North Korean KN-23s, to target energy facilities overnight.

items.title: Großbrand in Naftogaz - Anlage nach russischem Angriff
items.teaser: In der Nacht auf den 7. November hat Russland dreimal eine Anlage des Energiekonzerns "Naftogaz Ukraine" angegriffen. Ausrüstung ist beschädigt worden. Es brach ein Großbrand aus, teilt der kommissarische Vorstandsvorsitzende von Naftogaz, Serhij Fedorenko, auf Facebook mit. .

items.title: Ukraine's energy facilities hit 18 times in past 24 hours – energy minister
items.teaser: First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Energy Denys Shmyhal told German Federal Minister for Economic Affairs and Energy Katherina Reiche that Ukraine's energy facilities had been hit 18 times over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Heavy machinery arrives at protest against Russian grain transit in Latvia
items.teaser: A demonstration demanding a complete halt to the transport of agricultural products from Russia and occupied Ukrainian territories is taking place in Jēkabpils.

items.title: Finland considers installing Ukrainian-style anti-tank barriers to strengthen Russian border
items.teaser: Finland is studying the possibility of installing anti-tank obstacles modelled on Ukrainian ones to strengthen its border with Russia and NATO's eastern flank.

items.title: Ukraine: Massive Stromprobleme nach russischen Angriffen
items.teaser: Russische Attacken auf die Energie-und Verkehrsinfrastruktur der Ukraine haben in vielen Landesteilen schwere Schäden verursacht. In Kyjiw musste eine wichtige Brücke wieder gesperrt werden.

items.title: BND soll heimlich Wohnungen betreten dürfen
items.teaser: Union und SPD haben sich laut einem Politico-Bericht auf größere Geheimdienst-Befugnisse geeinigt. Demnach soll der BND heimlich Wohnungen betreten dürfen und der Verfassungsschutz kriminelle Netzwerke ins Visier nehmen.

items.title: Georgien nach Umzug vieler Kliniken aus Russland und der Ukraine neues Zentrum für Leihmutterschaften
items.teaser: Seit 2022 hat sich Georgien zu einer Drehscheibe für Leihmutterschaften entwickelt. Viele Kliniken aus Russland und der Ukraine sind wegen des Krieges dorthin umgezogen. Die DW hat mit Leihmüttern und Kunden gesprochen.

items.title: Russian attack on Kharkiv leaves two injured
items.teaser: Two people were injured as a result of a Russian attack on the Slobidskyi district of Kharkiv.

items.title: Selenskyj meldet nächtliche Angriffe auf Kyjiw und zwölf weitere Regionen
items.teaser: In der Ukraine wurden in der Nacht zum 7. November neben Kyjiw noch 12 weitere Regionen angegriffen.

items.title: Russian forces attack businesses in Kremenchuk
items.teaser: Russian drones struck the premises of private businesses at two locations in Kremenchuk.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russian missile launchers, air defense systems in Bryansk Oblast, General Staff says
items.teaser: The Iskander-M is one of Russia's principal ballistic weapons. Since the beginning of 2026, Moscow has launched more than 500 ballistic missiles against Ukraine.

items.title: Losing pace in the EU race: 2026 report reveals Ukraine is falling behind other candidates
items.teaser: The European Commission’s reports emphasise that nothing irreversible has happened yet. Ukraine is being kept in the same group for political reasons, even at the cost of delaying Moldova’s progress. But this can’t go on forever...

items.title: Russian drones attack businesses in Poltava region, four people injured
items.teaser: Four people were injured in Kremenchuk, Poltava region, as a result of a Russian attack on private businesses.

items.title: Ermittlungen zu Sabotage an Bahnstrecke Leipzig-Döbeln eingestellt
items.teaser: Nach Angaben der Generalstaatsanwaltschaft Dresden waren die ermittelten Verdächtigen zur Tatzeit im März strafunmündig.

items.title: Zuerst überflog ein US-Spionageflugzeug den Suwalki-Korridor, dann umkreiste es die russische Exklave Kaliningrad
items.teaser: Ein US-Aufklärungsflugzeug hat erneut eine Mission nahe Kaliningrad geflogen. Die Artemis II überquerte dabei zweimal den Suwałki-Korridor.

items.title: Schwere Schäden nach Raketenangriffen auf Kiew
items.teaser: Russland hat kurz vor Wintereinbruch erneut die ukrainische Strom- und Wasserversorgung angegriffen. In einigen Teilen des Landes fiel der Strom aus. Präsident Selenskyj und Kiews Bürgermeister Klitschko streiten über die Verteidigung.

items.title: Military intelligence identifies Russian soldiers involved in deadly Komyshuvakha aid center strike
items.teaser: Four Russian Su-34 fighter-bombers were involved in the operation, according to Ukraine's military intelligence (HUR).

items.title: Russland: Putins Schattenkrieg – Jetzt muss Europa zurückschlagen
items.teaser: Russland führt einen verdeckten Krieg gegen Europa – mit Drohnen, Brandanschlägen und Sabotage. Europa hat die Gefahr erkannt, doch die bisherige Reaktion reicht nicht aus.

items.title: Emergency power cuts introduced in Kyiv region
items.teaser: Emergency power cuts have been introduced in the Kyiv region.
